testimonials.text: First, the detailed explanation of different types of sutures, including absorbable and non-absorbable materials, helped me understand their specific indications and appropriate uses. The step-by-step demonstration of various suturing techniques, such as interrupted, continuous, and intradermal stitches, was very helpful in visualizing the practical application.
I found the different types of sutures and their uses the most interesting. I also liked learning how to choose the right suture for different types of wounds.
Covering the suture details, most of us just use the suture without knowing the details, just following our colleagues. A good insight into suture profiles is very much appreciated.
I liked seeing the different kind of suture techniques and seeing the videos of each one.

I found the hands-on demonstration of proper needle handling and wrist technique most interesting. Seeing the correct entry angle, spacing, and tension made the mechanics of suturing much clearer than just reading about it. I also appreciated the discussion on tissue handling and how proper technique directly impacts wound healing and patient outcomes.
I really appreciated how the course was set out as it was very direct and informative. I have done other suturing reviews and this was a nice compilation of them.

I found the section on suture materials and selection most interesting. Understanding the difference between absorbable sutures like Vicryl and non-absorbable sutures like Nylon and Prolene, and when to use monofilament vs multifilament, was very practical and will help me in my daily practice.
